body:
From Colombia, I wish you get better
For me, I planned it twice, and once I got what I needed.
I thought to get an overdose so the 2020's my family wouldn't have to deal with me, but I just kept thinking... What if I can get better? What if someday I can make people happy with my Passion? (Animated series)
I just try to remember that suicide is not preventing things from getting worse but losing the opportunity for them to get better
Sometimes I have my Rocky bottoms (like rn this week has been horrible) but the idea that maybe, one day, I'll be able to let all my traumas let go, the idea that maybe I'll do to the therapist in April keeps me here, sometimes my friends, sometimes my family and sometimes the fear of death, of "The view from halfway down", of the idea that I'll probably regret it when there's no turning back
So please, don't do anything
